part_1_hawkes.simulator: experiments/m5_02/design.json causal section, examples/hawkes_days.rs; base rates, decays, weights, diffusion, spread and kernel unchanged; made-up

impact_step.rule: the policy's own setting or the next higher: 0 to 0.25, 0.25 to 1, 1 to 2

perturbations.grid: product in the listed order, 24 points per setting, the unperturbed point first; ties take the first in grid order
perturbations.plausibility: bounds are #108's ranges; branching_scale multiplies every weight and each point must keep the spectral radius of Sum_u alpha_u, the matrix HawkesParameters::new checks, below 1, checked and recorded by code before any day is generated; a failing point is removed and reported

identifiability.rate: the market entry of (I - K)^-1 mu, K = Sum_u alpha_u with cross-excitation, mu = (limit x P(q < cap), cancel x E[q], market x P(q > 0)), each average time-weighted over the point's selection days. Tested: realised market orders per row at the point over the unperturbed point, against the same ratio of the formula; |ratio / ratio_formula - 1| <= 0.10
identifiability.impact: OLS slope of per-row mid change on the row's signed market orders; for impact_ticks > 0, |slope / impact_ticks - 1| <= 0.10; at impact 0, |slope| <= 0.025 ticks, 10 % of the smallest non-zero impact
identifiability.when: before freeze, with no policy; a failing point is reported and removed
identifiability.rate_reading: mu uses realised queue statistics, so the test checks the branching response given the realised queue, not the closed-loop rate. The crate masks the whole intensity at an empty queue and at the cap, so excited events are suppressed there and (I - K)^-1 overstates the response: a known approximation. Empty-queue and cap shares are reported per point. The 10 % is unmeasured and fixed before any ratio is computed, and a removal under it may reflect this approximation
identifiability.unperturbed: the rate check at the unperturbed point is true by construction (ratio 1 = 1) and carries no evidence; its impact slope is the only live test there

perturbations.removed_points: a point failing the spectral or identifiability check is removed before freeze. If it is the fixed stress, or the impact-only point, that condition is reported as not run, with no substitute. If the unperturbed point fails, that whole setting is reported as not run, since every comparison in it needs that point

part_1_hawkes.fixed_stress: market 2, limit 0.7, branching 1.2, next higher impact

adversary.picks: for each policy (the seeds of a learned arm being one policy), the point with the largest mean daily loss over its selection days; a tail statistic is not used since 10 days do not resolve one
adversary.information: parameters set before a day; sees nothing of its path; changes neither matching, accounting nor limits
adversary.used_on: selection days only; the holdout is not used by it
adversary.comparability: the mean-loss rule differs from #295's CVaR rule, so the two parts' adversary results are not comparable
adversary.selection_noise: 24 candidates pick up selection noise: the selected point's selection-day and holdout loss are reported side by side

part_1_hawkes.no_training: learned arms are loaded and verified by sha256 against #107's manifest and evaluated deterministically; this study trains nothing
part_1_hawkes.execution: #107 part C's: queue_position_rational, 1 lot per 500 ms, no minimum time; fee -0.0001 and the same limits and latency for every arm; #107's secondary fee 0.0002 is not run in this study

holdout.seed: 1000003 x day + 300000, day 1 to 30; #107's days used 1000003 + day, so no seed is reused

conditions: adversary at the policy's own selected point
impact only (next higher impact, flow unperturbed)
metrics: margin-rs maintenance requirement at the day's peak position, reported as a requirement
part_1_hawkes.margin_shortfall: not measured: this simulator has no declared capital and none is made up; margin-rs#7 gives a requirement, not a capital

intervals.kind: paired 90 % stationary block bootstrap over holdout days of the daily difference
intervals.pairs: each arm stressed against itself unperturbed, and against no-trade under the same condition

part_1_hawkes.reading: descriptive, per arm and setting. A loss is reported as a loss; an interval containing 0 is 'no difference shown', never equivalence or robustness; no adopt decision
part_1_hawkes.once: the holdout runs once from a frozen manifest, behind an O_EXCL marker claimed before any day is read, at the fixed path m5_10_markers, a sibling of the study's output directories, passed to the runner as an argument and named in the run's log, outside the output directory, with a frozen_sha256 check. One recovery at most, only after an external kill, resumed from the journal with the journal prefix's hash checked, as #281
part_1_hawkes.impact_meaning: impact here is the market orders' impact on the mid in the generator's rows; the agent's own fills do not move the mid, unlike #282's reactive episode, and no conclusion about own impact is drawn

secondary_not_identified.selection: the primary's adversary picks only among the 10 surviving points, computed without any secondary row. secondary_not_identified.reported: apart from the primary, in its own table, with each point's realised over formula ratio and queue shares
secondary_not_identified.isolation: primary jobs run first and are written out complete before any secondary job starts, in their own journals and outputs. A secondary failure or stop leaves the primary valid and is reported; a primary failure stops the attempt
secondary_not_identified.surviving_pick: the secondary's pick over all 24 points may land on a surviving point. secondary_not_identified.fixed_stress: the primary table keeps fixed_stress as not run, with no substitute; the secondary's fixed-stress row is never quoted as the primary's
secondary_not_identified.comparisons: the same pairs, intervals and metrics as the primary (each arm against itself unperturbed and against no-trade under the same condition), plus each point's realised over formula ratio and queue shares

primary_claim.claim: the primary's worst case is the worst over these surviving points, not over the declared grid. If the survivors are the milder flows, as the empty-queue pattern suggests, the primary does not cover the stressed region
